visualRisks.description: Waterfront district has a large empty space that might look uninteresting.
visualRisks.suggestion: Add more details or objects to the empty spaces.

visualRisks.description: The route path crosses through areas without roads, which may be confusing for players.
visualRisks.suggestion: Ensure routes are always on roads or consider adding a path overlay.

navigationRisks.description: Route points include non-existent cells (e.g., 27, 28, 16, etc.), which could lead to navigation errors.
navigationRisks.suggestion: Verify the route points against the district layout.

navigationRisks.description: The route does not have a clear starting or ending point, making it difficult for players to understand its purpose.
navigationRisks.suggestion: Define a start and end point for the route and ensure they are visually distinct.
